# anthropic_federation_rule_workspaces (Data Source)

Lists the workspaces a workload identity federation rule is enabled for. Requires `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_federation_rule_workspaces" "deploy" {
  federation_rule_id = "fdrl_01ExampleRuleId0000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `federation_rule_id` (String) Rule id (`fdrl_...`).

### Read-Only

- `workspaces` (Attributes List) Workspace bindings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces))

<a id="nestedatt--workspaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspaces`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the binding was created.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace id.
- `workspace_name` (String) Workspace name.
